approved_findings.location: Buffered interaction sequence and readiness text for US-01
approved_findings.summary: The draft story could pass after creating generated button 4 without pressing generated button 4.
approved_findings.observed_contradiction: The task behavior requires pressing the fourth generated button to clear the document; four append-producing clicks only make generated button 4 exist, so a fifth click is required.
approved_findings.impact: Without the correction, a future executor could implement or verify an off-by-one flow that leaves the fourth generated button unactivated while treating the plan as satisfied.
approved_findings.evidence: adversarial-review.md records AR-01 and the current plan-description.md section 8.1, 03-step-append-handler.md section 6.1, 04-step-finish-handler.md section 6.1, and ui-story-runs/US-01.md now require five clicks from the initial state.
approved_findings.required_correction: Keep the explicit five-click sequence: clicks 1-4 append generated buttons 1-4, and click 5 on generated button 4 clears the document and renders the exact final state.

approved_findings.summary: The plan contradicts itself on whether the future page loads with two initial buttons or one initial button.
approved_findings.observed_contradiction: plan-description.md section 3.1 says the deliverable loads with exactly two initial buttons, but W01 and downstream proof artifacts require exactly one visible initial button at load.
approved_findings.impact: A future executor following W01, W05, or US-01 would build and test the wrong initial DOM state, causing the implementation to miss the stated two-button requirement while still satisfying the plan's tests.
approved_findings.evidence: plan-description.md section 3.1 states 'exactly two initial buttons'; 01-step-initial-markup.md sections 4.1, 5.1, and 6.1 require exactly one button; work-unit-inventory.md W01 repeats one initial button; 02-proof-and-handoff/steps/01-step-dom-test.md section 6.1 says the test fails unless the initial button count is one; ui-story-runs/US-01.md says the starting state has one visible initial button.
approved_findings.required_correction: Change the implementation and proof work units to require exactly two initial buttons at load, and clarify that the first append click is on the current last of those initial buttons while earlier initial buttons do not append.

approved_findings.summary: The plan alternates between a black final border and a white final border.
approved_findings.observed_contradiction: plan-description.md section 3.1 requires the final lowercase finished text to have a visible black border, while the implementation, test, browser-story, inventory, and UI-story artifacts require a visible white border.
approved_findings.impact: A future implementation with a white border could pass the planned DOM and browser evidence while violating the stated final-state requirement for a black border.
approved_findings.evidence: plan-description.md section 3.1 says 'visible black border'; work-unit-inventory.md W04 and W05 say white border; 04-step-finish-handler.md sections 4.1, 5.1, and 6.1 require white border; 01-step-dom-test.md section 6.1 and 02-step-browser-story.md section 6.1 require white border; ui-user-stories.md and ui-story-runs/US-01.md also require white border.
approved_findings.required_correction: Normalize every implementation, DOM-test, browser-story, UI-story, inventory, and review artifact to require the same final border color as the authoritative task requirement, specifically a visible black border if plan-description.md section 3.1 is authoritative.
